entries.00015b47e0c29654: Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥842,541 million, up 6.4% year on year. On demand conditions, the company cites the following: in semiconductor and electrical equipment, demand in Greater China remained firm, mainly for digital devices such as home appliances and LCD panels, and semiconductor-related demand in Japan, North America and South Korea recovered from the second half of the year; in automotive, EV-related demand in Greater China remained solid, while North America, Japan and Europe continued to see customers postponing capital investment; machine tool-related demand was solid, mainly in Greater China and Japan; and demand for medical equipment, food machinery and other industries was sluggish. As the company has a single segment, it does not disclose a breakdown of net sales by product.

entries.08ff772293efdc93: These are devices such as solenoid valves that switch the direction of compressed air flow. In January 1971 the company began manufacturing and selling direct-acting solenoid valves. Together with drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, these make up the product group that the company calls 'pneumatic equipment'. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed a manifold-type compact 5-port solenoid valve supporting up to 64 stations and an angle seat valve with an added ATEX-compliant series.
entries.17795620dd2d311e: This is the sole business segment of the SMC Group, which manufactures and sells automatic control equipment, component devices essential to factory automation (FA). Its products consist of pneumatic equipment, including directional control equipment, drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, as well as temperature control equipment and sensors, among others. These are component parts built into production and conveying lines of automated factories, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, industrial robots and other equipment. The company positions itself as a 'general manufacturer of pneumatic equipment' that makes and sells all equipment used on compressed air piping, and cites as its competitive advantage a range of 880,000 items and a short-lead-time, immediate-delivery system backed by ample inventory. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥842,541 million (up 6.4% year on year), production was ¥843,896 million (up 12.8%), orders received were ¥872,261 million (up 13.2%), order backlog was ¥118,156 million (up 33.6%), and the number of employees was 24,773 (temporary employees of 5,616 are not included).

entries.5704d41cd8d620f6: These are devices for cleaning compressed air, regulating its pressure and supplying it to equipment. This product group, which began with the manufacture and sale of air triple sets in September 1961, is the first product group that SMC CORPORATION handled among its automatic control equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company developed stainless-steel compressed air cleaning filters, in-line air filters, booster valves, remote adjustment valves (electric speed controllers), membrane nitrogen generators and others. Products in this area also underpin proposals such as '4BAR factory', which lowers air pressure across an entire factory, 'AMS (air management system)', which constantly monitors air usage and automatically lowers pressure according to equipment operation, and 'energy-saving booster valves', which boost pressure locally only where needed.

entries.880d90a369a6197a: It supplies automation control equipment, consisting of pneumatic equipment such as directional control equipment, drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, plus temperature control equipment and sensors, with a range of 880,000 items. The company describes this as a “one-stop shop” where, if you order from the company group, you can find any automation control equipment you need. Its strength is making products smaller and lighter, and it explains that making pneumatic equipment lighter reduces the weight of equipment and robots, which in turn reduces energy consumption across customers’ factories. About 20% of a factory’s power consumption is said to come from the operation of compressors that produce compressed air, and it proposes the “4BAR factory,” which lowers air pressure across the whole factory, the “AMS (air management system),” which constantly monitors air use and automatically lowers pressure, and “energy-saving booster valves,” which boost pressure locally only where needed. In more than 50 countries, about 200 sales staff carry out more than 600 “energy-saving diagnoses” a year, and sales of products defined as “environmentally conscious products” account for about 80% of total Group sales. R&D expenses for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥39,986 million (up 19.9% year on year), and in March 2026 it opened the Japan Technical Center (JTC) in Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture, as the core of its research and development, working with technology centers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany and China.
entries.8e4260ee186b4778: Gross profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥381,452 million (up 5.1% year on year), and the gross profit margin fell 0.6 percentage points year on year to 45.3%, mainly due to a higher cost ratio and increases in personnel expenses and depreciation. Selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥190,893 million (up 10.5% year on year), and operating profit was ¥190,558 million (up 0.2% year on year), with the operating margin down 1.4 percentage points year on year to 22.6%. Non-operating income included a foreign exchange gain of ¥19,693 million (compared with a foreign exchange loss of ¥4,468 million in the previous year), and as a result ordinary profit was ¥235,591 million (up 12.2% year on year), with an ordinary margin of 28.0%. Profit before income taxes was ¥236,989 million, and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥167,302 million (up 7.0% year on year). The company explains that steady capital investment worsens profitability in the short term through the burden of depreciation but strengthens competitiveness over the medium to long term, and payments for the acquisition of property, plant and equipment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥152,701 million. Borrowings at period-end were ¥5,092 million, and cash and cash equivalents were ¥573,769 million.

entries.f0022b5cb91b5144: The SMC Group consists of the company and 71 subsidiaries (69 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 non-consolidated subsidiaries), and is a single segment, the Automatic Control Equipment Business. In its management philosophy, the company sets as its social mission "contributing to the automation and labor saving of industry," and states that it will devote itself to its role as a component manufacturer and concentrate management resources on its core Automatic Control Equipment Business. What it sells is not equipment but components built into customers' factory production and conveying lines, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools and industrial robots, and the unit price per 1 item is relatively low. However, if a defect or stock shortage stops a line, the customer suffers major losses, so immediate delivery on short lead times is extremely important competitively. The company therefore has a lineup of 880,000 items and strategically ample inventory, and has a network of more than 500 bases in more than 80 countries and regions with about 7,000 sales staff, delivering through both direct sales and distributors. Customer accounts number 700,000, and no counterparty accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue. The company explains that once adopted, customers tend to keep buying the same products for a long period until they next update the drawings of their lines or equipment.
